versions.changelog: All commands' --json output now shares one consistent shape: {ok, command, criteria, results, count, warning, error}, with flat venue objects that always carry venue_id, name and booking_url. Payloads shrink 32-97% (info 42KB -> 1.3KB, availability 79KB -> 20KB) with no facts dropped - verified by a fidelity suite that diffs against the raw upstream and fetches sample booking links to confirm they render. Booking links are now embedded in availability, check and range output, so agents no longer need follow-up url calls. The previous unprocessed output remains available via --raw. Human-readable output is unchanged. If you parse --json programmatically, adapt to the new shape or pass --raw.

Fixes dead booking links: ids taken from available output are temporary search ids, and the url command used to echo them into pages that render nothing. Such ids are now recovered to the canonical booking page (verified live), and unrecoverable ids get an actionable error instead of a dead link. Dates now accept weekday names - friday means the next Friday, today included - so there's no error-prone day arithmetic. Adds regression tests for both.

Fixes: range date column no longer truncated; SKILL.md check example used a nonexistent --time flag (now positional); search --city now actually filters (client-side by address, Hebrew and English), warns on multi-city regions, errors on unknown cities. Rewritten description for better skill routing. New offline docs-conformance test.
